title: DELETE /api/projects/:id/github/disconnect — remove GitHub repo link
description: Allow users to disconnect a GitHub repo from a project. Clears github_repo_id and github_repo_name but does NOT delete imported commits/releases (they remain in the timeline).
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE requires auth and project ownership
Returns 400 if no GitHub repo is connected
Clears github_repo_id and github_repo_name on the project
Imported commits and releases remain in the database

steps.details: In github.ts router: DELETE /disconnect. 1) getOwnedProject. 2) If project.github_repo_name is null, return 400. 3) Update project: github_repo_id = null, github_repo_name = null. 4) Return 200.
In index.ts, mount: app.use('/api/projects/:id/github', requireAuth, githubRouter).
Connect repo, import commits, disconnect. Verify project has no github_repo_name. Verify commits/releases still exist in DB and timeline.
